notes_for_editor: Only one page describes this tower: the Forest Lookouts c.1938 entry, which calls it a secondary telephone pole tower. Nothing read gives a builder, height, staffing, fate or site description. The Forest Fire Lookout Association Illinois list (firelookout.org/lookouts/us/il/) has no Saline County entries and no Cave Hill, so it is not confirmed there. The historical marker is forest context only and does not name this site. One WebSearch found nothing on a Cave Hill tower; its summary suggested Melcher Hill, but the register places Melcher Hill in Hardin County, so it was not used. Search-result summaries were not used. The story is about 125 words, the most this evidence supports without padding. The record's kind 'tower' is consistent with the source's telephone pole tower; the brief has no height, and none is given in the source.
